label: Websites in a browser
summary: Opens and reads web pages in a real browser; in a Work workspace it can also click, fill forms and take screenshots.

coreWhy.files.read: Reads task files in the workspace.

steps: Open the pages involved and read them before acting
limits: Never submit a form that sends money, messages or personal data unless the task asks for exactly that.
starters: Open the start page and describe what's on it. Don't submit anything.

questions.label: What it can do
questions.text: In an Inspect workspace it only opens and reads pages; in Work it can also click, fill forms and take screenshots. It uses a fresh browser with no saved logins.
